text:
anya_cs: Quick heads-up — SlateHealth goes live Thurs. They asked for a short customer-facing runbook focused on caching, batching, and streaming. Can we draft a single-page operational runbook and a 3-step play for renewal-risk signals?

dave_eng: +1. I'll draft the technical checklist (batch sizes, KV cache warmup, stream fallback). Need the SLA targets and which model variant to recommend.

sophie_prod: SLA: 99.9% p95 <= 500ms on chat tokens. Recommend model: rwd-medium-quant (fast fallback rwd-small-quant). Add canary policy.

kevin_se: We should include a short onboarding status table for the CS handoff: prefill tokens, warm pool size, sample traffic curve. I'll add a minimal template.

anya_cs: Good. Also want a quick renewal-risk play: if latency breaches or errors > 1% for 24h, CS to trigger exec sync and credit discussion. Keep it customer-facing but blunt.

maria_cs: I'll write the customer-facing intro and the single-page PDF copy. Keep language non‑technical and include one troubleshooting checklist they can copy into their runbook.

sam_sre: Flag: include the exact commands to validate cache/batch config and streaming healthchecks. Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/health` and check `x-cache-status` header.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — canary for rwd-medium-quant scheduled 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.

anya_cs: Draft runbook outline (one-pager):
  1) What we recommend (short bullets)
  2) Before you go live (preflight quick checks)
  3) Live day playbook (L1/L2 triage steps)
  4) Auto-fallback & rollback plan
  5) Renewal & escalation triggers
  6) Contact list & on-call windows

dave_eng: Filling in 2) Preflight quick checks (technical):
  - Prefill: run 1k sample requests against prefix to populate KV cache. Expect >60% cache-hit within first 10m.
  - Batching: set target batch_size=16 for rwd-medium-quant; monitor avg_batch_time and token throughput.
  - Streaming: test chunked responses with a 1s cadence; validate client reconnection logic (resume vs restart).
  - Canary: run 10% traffic to canary for 2 hours, validate p95 and error delta < 0.1%.

sam_sre: Commands (put in their runbook):
  - Check cache warmup: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/rwd-medium-quant/generate \
    -d '{"input":"<sample prefix>","max_tokens":16}' | jq -r '.headers["x-cache-status"]'`
  - Validate batching: poll `/metrics` endpoint for `avg_batch_size` and `avg_batch_latency` during load.
  - Streaming health: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/chat -d '{"input":"ping","stream":true}'` and ensure incremental events every 150-300ms.

kevin_se: Live day playbook (L1):
  - If p95 > SLA or errors > 0.5% for 30m -> scale dedicated pool + notify CS and SRE.
  - If model fallback triggers > 2% traffic -> open rollback and engage product.

kevin_se: Live day (L2):
  - Capture sample request IDs (use `request_id` header) for failed traces.
  - Trigger debug capture: `POST /internal/debug-capture` (SRE only).

anya_cs: Renewal-trigger matrix (customer-facing):
  - Green: Meets SLA and usage growth > 10% month-over-month -> outreach for expansion.
  - Yellow: Minor SLA blips (single-day incident) or usage stable -> proactive enablement call + warroom summary.
  - Red: Repeated latency/errors or usage drop > 20% -> CS + sales Exec sync within 48h, propose credit or joint remediation plan.

maria_cs: I'll phrase it as: "We track service health and collaborate quickly — if we see repeated issues we'll set a remediation plan and discuss commercial options." Keep blunt but empathetic.

sophie_prod: Add observability links they'll find useful: per-route dashboard, token-cost breakdown, and the per-request `x-fallback-reason` header. Also add a small diagram for cache vs prefix prefill.

dave_eng: Quick fallback guidance to include:
  - Auto-fallback order: rwd-medium-quant -> rwd-small-quant -> rwd-embed-low (for embeddings).
  - Fallback rate limit: if fallback rate > 5% sustained for 1h, auto-threshold to block new sessions and escalate.

anya_cs: Troubleshooting checklist (customer copy):
  - Step 1: Confirm client uses streaming/resume protocol (if using streaming).
  - Step 2: Confirm prefill step ran and KV cache hit rate > 50% after 10m.
  - Step 3: If latency high, switch to smaller model variant (instructions included).
  - Step 4: Capture 3 sample requests and send to CS with `request_id`.

kevin_se: Who's owning the PDF? maria_cs? also add short sections: "How to run a warmup script" and "How to validate your SDK integration".

maria_cs: I'll own the PDF and the customer email template. ETA: EOD tomorrow. I'll paste the draft here for review before sending.

sam_sre: Add an incident quick-run command for CS to paste into warroom:

# quick warroom snapshot
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?service=customerslate | jq .

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary completed: rwd-medium-quant stable at 02:45 UTC, no anomalies.

anya_cs: Perfect. Action items: dave_eng -> tech checklist + commands (today), maria_cs -> PDF + email template (EOD tomorrow), sam_sre -> warroom snippets + validation commands (today), kevin_se -> renewal matrix copy + handoff table (today).

maria_cs: Will post draft PDF link here when ready.

anya_cs: Thanks team — goal: 1-page customer runbook + 3-step renewal play handed to customer on go-live. Keep it copyable. :heart:
